drafts.subject: Catalogue copy
drafts.body:
Hi,

972+ handwoven rugs, each needing its own description, tags, and size specs. Writing and maintaining those unique, on-brand listings for every rug is a heavy, repetitive drag that slows catalog updates and risks inconsistent messaging.

We build a simple AI content engine that takes your product data and auto-generates polished, SEO-friendly descriptions and tags in bulk, with your brand voice.

Open to seeing a sample description written for one of your rugs?
drafts.research_summary:
HOOK: You’re managing 972+ handwoven rugs with individual descriptions, tags, and size specs—each needing to sound authentic for an Afghan-crafted brand.

PROBLEM: Manually writing and maintaining those unique, on-brand listings for every rug is a heavy, repetitive drag that slows catalog updates and risks inconsistent messaging.

PROJECT: Build a simple AI content engine that takes your product data (size, material, style) and auto-generates polished, SEO-friendly descriptions and tags in bulk, with your brand voice.

OUTCOME: Your team cuts hours per new collection, listings stay consistent, and you can scale to 1,000+ products without adding headcount or missing the artisan story.

drafts.subject: Custom rug quotes
drafts.body:
Hi,

Your site kabulrugs.com suggests you specialize in authentic Afghan rugs, a niche inventory that requires expert matching and detailed provenance tracking.

Manually fielding custom inquiries, verifying stock in a back-and-forth, and explaining origin history probably slows your sales cycle and risks losing buyers who get faster answers elsewhere.

We can build a lightweight internal tool that logs rug details (size, knot density, age, region) and instantly surfaces matching inventory, paired with a customer-facing form that auto-generates a personalized quote with provenance highlights.

Open to seeing a quick mockup of how this would look for your catalog?
drafts.research_summary:
HOOK: Your site kabulrugs.com suggests you specialize in authentic Afghan rugs — a niche inventory that requires expert matching and detailed provenance tracking.

PROBLEM: Manually fielding custom rug inquiries, verifying stock, and explaining origin stories slows your sales cycle and risks losing customers who buy from faster competitors.

PROJECT: Build a simple internal tool that lets staff log rug details (size, knot density, age, region) and instantly surface matching inventory from your catalog, plus a customer-facing form that auto-generates a personalized quote with provenance highlights.

OUTCOME: Replying to inquiries in minutes instead of hours, fewer missed sales, and a more consistent customer experience without adding headcount.
